question: A company needs to run an application on Amazon EC2 instances. The running workload cannot be interrupted. The company needs an instance purchasing option that requires no commitment. Which instance purchasing option will meet these requirements MOST cost effectively?

options.explanation: With On-Demand Instances, you only pay for the compute power that you use. You can pay by the hour or by the second. There is no time commitment.
Dedicated Hosts give you the ability to use server-bound licenses. However, Dedicated Hosts are more expensive than non- dedicated hosts.
Reserved Instances can provide significant discounts. However, Reserved Instances require a 1-year or 3-year commitment.

Spot Instances provide discounted rates for EC2 instances. However, you should use Spot Instances for applications or workloads that have flexible start times and stop times. A Spot Instance only runs when capacity is available. Therefore, this instance type is not feasible for a workload that cannot be interrupted.

question: A developer needs to access AWS resources from the AWS CLI. Which feature in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) can the developer use for authentication?

options.explanation: IAM policies define the permissions of IAM identities and AWS resources. You cannot use IAM policies as credentials to access AWS.
SSH keys are a network method for remote server access. You cannot use SSH keys for authentication with the AWS CLI.

You can use an account password policy to define the necessary complexity and mandatory password rotation period of passwords for IAM users. You cannot use an account password policy to access AWS programmatically.
IAM access keys are short-term or long-term credentials. Access keys give you the ability to access AWS programmatically.

question: Which tasks are the customer's responsibility, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Physically secure the data center hardware.
options.explanation: The customer cannot access data centers. Therefore, the customer is not responsible for physically securing hardware in a data center.
AWS is responsible for physical hardware. Therefore, AWS is responsible for decommissioning deprecated storage devices.
The customer has full responsibility to configure all firewall routes in relation to the operating system and application. AWS is not responsible for configuring the customer firewall.
The customer does not have physical access to the network hardware. Therefore, the customer is not responsible for patching network hardware. AWS is responsible for patching network hardware.
The customer has full responsibility to patch operating systems and applications. AWS is not responsible for patching the guest operating system.

question: What is a responsibility of AWS under the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Update the guest operating systems on deployed Amazon EC2 instances.
options.explanation: The customer must manage updates on the customer's provisioned infrastructure.

options.text: Configure new resources within an AWS account.
options.explanation: The customer decides which services to use and how to use them.
AWS fully maintains the physical controls.

options.text: Design a customer's application for disaster recovery.
options.explanation: AWS offers many services to help with disaster recovery and business continuity planning. However, according to the shared responsibility model, it is the customer’s responsibility to decide which services to use.

question: A cloud practitioner is developing a disaster recovery plan and intends to replicate data between multiple geographic areas. Which component of the AWS Cloud should the company use to meet these requirements?

options.explanation: A Region is a named set of AWS resources in the same geographic area. A Region comprises at least two Availability Zones. Regions would be the appropriate way to replicate data in a DR plan.

While edge locations are global, they are used to perform service-specific operations. For example, Amazon CloudFront, the content delivery network (CDN) service, uses edge locations to cache static and dynamic content. Edge locations are not designed to support DR.

An Availability Zone is one or more discrete data centers with redundant power, networking, and connectivity within an AWS Region. For a DR plan, it is a best practice to replicate the data between separate geographic areas.
AWS accounts control resources and payment for the AWS activity that is related to these resources. AWS accounts are unrelated to geographic areas.

question: A company has a stateless application that can handle interruptions. The application must be available all day and night. Traffic increases heavily during business hours. Which instance types for base and peak traffic are MOST cost-efficient to meet these requirements?

options.text: On-Demand Instances for base traffic and On-Demand Instances with auto scaling for peak traffic
options.explanation: On-Demand Instances are more expensive when compared to Spot Instances or Reserved Instances because the price is fixed. If you use only On-Demand instances, it would not be the most cost-effective instance type for base or peak traffic.

options.text: On-Demand Instances for base traffic and Spot Instances for peak traffic using an Amazon EC2 Fleet
options.explanation: On-Demand Instances would not be the most cost-effective purchase option for base traffic. Because the base traffic requires the application to be available all day and night, you can use Reserved Instances. This setup provides you with cost savings because Reserved Instances are less expensive when compared to On-Demand Instances.

options.text: Reserved Instances for base traffic and Spot Instances for peak traffic using an Amazon EC2 Fleet
options.explanation: Reserved Instances are cost-effective for base traffic because you can commit to use a certain capacity over a one-year or three-year agreement. Reserved Instances give you the ability to realize cost savings when you receive a discount for your Reserved Instance contract. Spot Instances for peak traffic gives you the ability to take advantage of discounted EC2 capacity. When combined with EC2 Fleet, you can set capacity targets that use your instance types to accommodate both predictable base traffic and peak traffic.

options.text: Reserved Instances for both the base and peak traffic
options.explanation: Reserved Instances have a one-year or three-year commitment. Reserved Instances are not cost-effective for a workload that only peaks during business hours.

question: A company is building a web application using AWS. Which AWS service will help prevent network layer DDoS attacks against the web application?

options.explanation: Firewall Manager is a security management service. You can use Firewall Manager to centrally configure and manage firewall rules across your accounts and applications. Firewall Manager can help manage security policies such as AWS WAF rules. However, Firewall Manager alone does not provide DDoS protection. Firewall Manager is primarily a management tool for other security services.

Shield is a managed DDoS protection service. Shield helps protect applications that run on AWS. Shield automatically protects AWS resources from common DDoS attacks on the network and transport layers.

AWS WAF protects web applications from specific web exploits. With AWS WAF, you can define customizable web security rules. You can use AWS WAF to protect against SQL injection, cross-site scripting, and other application-level attacks. However, AWS WAF does not help prevent network layer DDoS attacks.

GuardDuty is a threat detection service. GuardDuty continuously monitors your AWS accounts and workloads for malicious activity and unauthorized behavior. GuardDuty can detect some aspects of DDoS attacks after the attacks occur. However, GuardDuty is primarily a monitoring and detection service, not a protection mechanism against active DDoS attacks.

question: A company wants to ensure that two Amazon EC2 instances are in separate data centers with minimal communication latency between the data centers. How can the company meet this requirement?

options.text: Place the EC2 instances in two separate Availability Zones within the same AWS Region.
options.explanation: The use of two Availability Zones in the same Region ensures low latency and provides protection against failure of one Availability Zone.

options.text: Place the EC2 instances in two separate AWS Regions connected with a VPC peering connection.
options.explanation: Although separate Regions can achieve the requirement of separate facilities, it is not the best option for low latency.

options.text: Place both EC2 instances in a placement group for dedicated bandwidth.
options.explanation: There are no placement groups with dedicated bandwidth. Placement groups can only run within the same Availability Zone to minimize latency.

options.text: Place one EC2 instance on premises and the other in an AWS Region. Then connect them by using an AWS
options.explanation: VPN connection. An EC2 instance cannot be run outside of AWS unless you have AWS Outposts servers installed on-premises. Although deploying an EC2 instance to another Region would meet the separate data center requirement, it would not ensure low latency.

question: Which AWS service or feature can a developer use to access AWS services programmatically?

options.explanation: CodeDeploy is a deployment service used to automate application deployments on AWS compute resources, which includes on-premises instances.
CodePipeline is a continuous delivery service used to model, visualize, and automate the entire software release process up to production.
With AWS SDK, users can programmatically access AWS services with an API from the programming languages of your choice.
AWS Management Console does not provide programmatic access to AWS services. The Management Console gives users the ability to interact with AWS services through a web user interface.

question: A company wants to improve its security and audit posture by limiting Amazon EC2 inbound access. What should the company use to access instances remotely instead of opening inbound SSH ports and managing SSH keys?

options.explanation: Session Manager is a node management service for the cloud or for on-premises compute units. Session Manager provides a secure connection through shell scripting. You can establish the connection without the need to open ports.

A network ACL is an additional layer of security for your VPC. Network ACLs act as a firewall that controls traffic in and out of one or more subnets. You would not use network ACLs to connect to EC2 instances remotely.
EC2 key pairs provide authorization when you make an SSH connection with security keys.
You can use IAM to create users, roles, groups, and policies that authorize access to your AWS resources. However, you would not use IAM to connect to EC2 instances remotely.

question: Which of the following will help a user determine if they need to request a VPC service limit increase?

options.explanation: Health Dashboard gives you the ability to see the status and health of all AWS services. The dashboard also shows reported service-related events for services across AWS Regions.
Cost and Usage Report tracks your AWS usage and provides estimated charges associated with your account.
Service Catalog gives IT administrators the ability to create, manage, and distribute portfolios of approved products to end users.

Trusted Advisor performs many checks on your AWS environment and makes recommendations for improvement. One of these checks includes VPC service limit checks, which you can use to determine if you need a VPC service limit increase.

question: A company needs access to cloud support engineers 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. What is the LEAST expensive AWS Support plan that meets this requirement?

options.explanation: Business Support+ is the least expensive support plan that includes access to cloud support engineers 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
Enterprise Support provides access to cloud support engineers 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. However, this support plan is more expensive than Business Support.

AWS Unified Operations provides 24 hours a day, 7 days a week access to cloud support engineers, but it is a higher-tier plan than Business Support+ and is therefore more expensive. It is not the least expensive option that meets the requirement.
Basic Support provides access to customer service, documentation, and whitepapers 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. However, Basic Support does not provide access to a cloud support engineer.

question: Which architecture design principle applies to the concept of rightsizing the AWS Cloud infrastructure?

options.explanation: The solution to make frequent, small, reversible changes is a design principle related to the operational excellence pillar. This solution does not relate to rightsizing.
The solution to perform operations as code is a design principle related to the operational excellence pillar. This solution does not include rightsizing.

You can use metrics from the currently running workload to select the right size and type to optimize for cost. This solution is one of the best practices on the cost optimization pillar for the Well-Architected Framework.

options.text: Scale horizontally for increased workload availability.
options.explanation: You can scale horizontally to increase aggregate workload availability as part of the reliability pillar. However, this solution does not relate to rightsizing.

question: A company needs to audit its AWS resources. The company must document any changes that have been made to the resources. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?

options.explanation: AWS Config is a fully managed service that can provide inventory and configuration history audit reports of AWS resources.
CloudWatch collects and tracks metrics to help monitor AWS resources in real time. CloudWatch does not audit or document changes to AWS resources.
AWS Artifact provides a central location to access AWS security and compliance reports and agreements. AWS Artifact does not audit or document changes to AWS resources.

Amazon Inspector scans AWS workloads, including Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) container images, and AWS Lambda functions. Amazon Inspector scans these workloads for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure. Amazon Inspector does not audit or document changes to AWS resources.

question: Which AWS service can help a company detect an outage of its website servers and redirect users to alternate servers?

options.explanation: CloudFront provides the ability for static or dynamic data to be cached at edge locations as a content delivery network (CDN) solution. This solution alleviates the need to provision additional servers in the cloud to supply the data for a client to access. CloudFront does not redirect users to alternate servers in the event of an outage.
GuardDuty is a security service that monitors your workloads for unusual activity and unauthorized access. GuardDuty does not redirect users to alternate servers in the event of an outage.
Route 53 resolves domain names to IP addresses through records. You can use Route 53 routing policies for failover routing to another set of resources.

Trusted Advisor analyzes your account and produces recommendations on cost optimization, performance, security, fault tolerance, and service limits for your workloads. Trusted Advisor does not redirect users to alternate servers in the event of an outage.

question: Which service can a customer use to set up a management payer account to view consolidated billing reports?

options.explanation: You can use AWS Budgets to track and to act on AWS accounts costs and usage. You cannot use AWS Budgets to consolidate billing reports.
QuickSight is a business intelligence service that delivers insights with dashboards. You cannot use QuickSight to consolidate billing reports.

Macie is a security service that uses machine learning and pattern matching to automatically discover, classify, and protect sensitive data in Amazon S3. You cannot use Macie to consolidate billing reports.

Organizations is an account management service that gives you the ability to consolidate multiple AWS accounts to centrally manage. Consolidated billing is a feature in Organizations that you can use to consolidate billing and payment for multiple AWS accounts.

question: What is a benefit of moving to the AWS Cloud in terms of improving time to market?

options.explanation: Security is an important consideration when you move to the AWS Cloud. However, security does not relate to the time necessary to deploy applications to market.

Businesses that move to the AWS Cloud can become more agile. IT resources are available to deploy within minutes. Businesses can deploy new features or applications much quicker because resources are readily available.
Backup capabilities are a benefit of the AWS Cloud. However, backup capabilities do not relate to the time necessary to deploy applications to market.

When you move to the AWS Cloud, you can deploy resources quickly. Resources can be available within minutes. Therefore, deployment speed will increase as a result of moving to the AWS Cloud, not decrease.

question: Which AWS Support plan includes a designated AWS technical account manager (TAM)?

options.explanation: Enterprise Support includes access to a designated TAM.
AWS Basic Support does not include a designated TAM. A TAM is exclusive to AWS Enterprise Support.
AWS Unified Operations does not include a designated TAM. Instead, it provides designated domain specialist engineers and incident management engineers. A TAM is exclusive to AWS Enterprise Support.
AWS Business Support+ does not include a designated TAM. A TAM is exclusive to AWS Enterprise Support.

question: A company does not own a physical data center but needs a network solution that connects employee laptops directly to the AWS Cloud. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?

options.explanation: Amazon Connect is a cloud-based contact center service that is used to provide customer service. Amazon Connect does not provide a direct network connection to AWS for individual laptops.

CloudFront is a web service that speeds up distribution of your static and dynamic web content, such as .html, .css, .js, and image files, to your users. CloudFront delivers your content through a worldwide network of data centers known as edge locations. CloudFront does not provide a direct network connection to AWS for individual laptops.

Outposts is a fully managed service that extends AWS infrastructure, services, APIs, and tools to customer premises. Outposts provides local access to AWS managed infrastructure. Outposts gives users the ability to build and run applications on premises by using the same programming interfaces as in AWS Regions. Outposts uses local compute and storage resources for lower latency and local data processing needs. Outposts does not provide a direct connection to AWS for individual laptops.

Client VPN is a managed client-based VPN service that gives you the ability to securely access your AWS resources and the resources in your on-premises network. With Client VPN, you can access your resources from any location through an OpenVPN-based VPN client.

question: A company has an Amazon EC2 instance that must access AWS Secrets Manager to retrieve credentials. Which identity or service is required by the EC2 instance to perform the task?

options.explanation: MFA is a feature of AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). MFA adds an extra layer of protection by requiring a second authentication factor for sign-in credentials. MFA does not provide an EC2 instance with access to Secrets Manager.
An IAM group is a collection of IAM users that you can use to provide permissions to a group of users. You cannot use an IAM group to access Secrets Manager.
The EC2 instance will require an instance profile associated with an IAM role to be able to access Secrets Manager. The IAM role will provide the necessary permissions to the EC2 instance.
Security groups are a feature of Amazon VPC. Security groups attach to EC2 instances to control network traffic. Security groups do not provide an EC2 instance with access to Secrets Manager.

question: A company needs to perform queries and interactively search and analyze log data. Which AWS service or feature will meet this requirement?

options.explanation: CloudWatch anomaly detection uses machine learning algorithms to detect anomalies in metrics. CloudWatch anomaly detection does not provide interactive query capabilities for log data analysis.

EventBridge is a serverless event bus service that connects application components together. EventBridge can process events from logs. However, you cannot use EventBridge to interactively search and analyze log data.

CloudWatch Logs streams are sequences of log events that share the same source. CloudWatch Logs streams store log data. However, CloudWatch Logs streams do not independently provide interactive query and analysis capabilities.

You can use CloudWatch Logs Insights to interactively search and analyze log data. CloudWatch Logs Insights provides a purpose-built query language for log analysis. You can query multiple log groups in a single operation.

question: Which AWS service can create copies of resources across AWS Regions?

options.explanation: You can use CloudFormation to model your infrastructure as code. You can use CloudFormation to create identical copies of resources across different Regions. By using the same template in multiple Regions, CloudFormation provides a consistent and repeatable deployment of resources. You can use CloudFormation to create cross-Region copies of your infrastructure.

Systems Manager is a management service that you can use to automate operational tasks across AWS resources. Systems Manager can manage resources across Regions. However, you cannot use Systems Manager to create copies of resources across Regions.

CloudTrail is a service that logs API activity and events across your AWS infrastructure. You can configure CloudTrail to work across multiple Regions for logging purposes. However, CloudTrail does not provide the ability to create copies of AWS resources.
ElastiCache is a fully managed in-memory caching service. ElastiCache can replicate data within a Region for high availability. However, ElastiCache cannot copy general AWS resources across Regions.

question: A company is migrating an application to AWS. As part of the migration, the company needs to move the application’s database to Amazon RDS. Which AWS service should the company use to migrate the database?

options.explanation: AWS DMS is designed to help migrate databases to AWS. AWS DMS provides minimal downtime during the migration process. AWS DMS can migrate the application's database to Amazon RDS.
You can use Application Migration Service to migrate applications and any associated servers to AWS. However, you cannot use Application Migration Service for database migration.
You can use AWS SCT to convert database schemas from one database engine to another. You can use AWS SCT in conjunction with AWS DMS. However, AWS SCT alone cannot migrate the database.

Migration Evaluator is a tool that you can use to analyze on-premises environments. Migration Evaluator can create business cases for AWS Cloud migrations. Migration Evaluator helps assess and plan migrations by providing cost and resource projections. However, Migration Evaluator alone cannot perform database migrations. Migration Evaluator is an assessment tool, not a migration service.

question: Which benefit does Amazon Rekognition provide?

options.text: The ability to resize millions of images automatically
options.explanation: Amazon Rekognition uses pre-trained machine learning models to detect objects in images. However, Amazon Rekognition does not resize the image.

options.text: The ability to detect objects that appear in pictures
options.explanation: Amazon Rekognition uses pre-trained machine learning models to detect objects in images.

options.text: The ability to place watermarks on images
options.explanation: Amazon Rekognition uses pre-trained machine learning models to detect objects in images. However, Amazon Rekognition does not add watermarks to the image.

options.text: The ability to bid on object detection jobs
options.explanation: Amazon Rekognition uses pre-trained machine learning models to detect objects in images. However, Amazon Rekognition does not bid on object detection jobs.

question: Which of the following are security principles in the AWS Well-Architected Framework?

options.explanation: Deploy globally in minutes is a principle of the performance efficiency pillar of the Well-Architected Framework.

options.text: Protect data in transit and at rest.
options.explanation: To protect data in transit and at rest is a principle of the security pillar of the Well-Architected Framework.
Perform operations as code is a principle of the operational excellence pillar of the Well-Architected Framework.

options.text: Monitor, alert, and audit actions and changes to AWS resources.
options.explanation: Traceability includes monitor and alert actions. Traceability is a principle of the security pillar of the Well-Architected Framework.
Analyze and attribute expenditures is a principle of the cost optimization pillar of the Well-Architected Framework.

question: Which AWS database service provides in-memory data storage?

options.explanation: ElastiCache is a fully managed in-memory data caching service for databases.
Timestream is a database service for time series data that you can persist to durable storage. Therefore, Timestream is not in-memory data storage.

Amazon RDS is a fully managed service for relational databases engines, including Amazon Aurora, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, and MariaDB. None of these engines provide in-memory data storage.
DynamoDB is a key-value data store that you can use to persist writes to durable storage. Therefore, DynamoDB is not in- memory data storage.

question: Which AWS benefit enables users to deploy cloud infrastructure that consists of multiple geographic Regions connected by a network with low latency, high throughput, and redundancy?

options.explanation: AWS achieves economies of scale by the aggregation of usage from hundreds of thousands of customers in the cloud. This benefit leads to lower pay-as-you-go prices. However, this benefit does not provide a connected network with low latency, high throughput, and redundancy.

AWS global infrastructure provides the benefit of global reach. AWS global infrastructure consists of multiple geographic Regions that are connected by a network with low latency, high throughput, and redundancy.

Elasticity gives you the ability to automatically add resources when demand increases. Additionally, you can automatically remove or scale down the resources when demand decreases. However, this benefit does not provide a connected network with low latency, high throughput, and redundancy.

AWS provides many services and features to ensure that customers can deploy resources globally in a secure and controlled manner. However, this benefit does not provide a connected network with low latency, high throughput, and redundancy.

question: A company wants to build a data analytics application that uses Amazon Redshift. The company needs a cost estimate for its future Amazon Redshift usage. Which AWS tool will provide a high-level cost estimation?

options.explanation: AWS Pricing Calculator gives you the ability to create estimates for your AWS use cases before you build the applications. AWS Pricing Calculator can provide a cost estimate.

You can use AWS Budgets to set custom cost and usage budgets. You can use AWS Budgets to receive alerts when existing workloads exceed the forecast or the budget. You would not use AWS Budgets for cost estimates.

Savings Plans are a flexible pricing model that you can use for cost savings based on your AWS compute usage. You would use Savings Plans primarily for EC2 instances pricing cost optimization. You would not use Savings Plans for cost estimates.
Cost Explorer gives you the ability to visualize, understand, and manage your AWS costs and usage over time. You would not use Cost Explorer for cost estimates.

question: A company plans to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to use the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) to define and track business outcomes as part of its cloud transformation journey. Which AWS CAF governance perspective capability will meet these requirements?

options.explanation: Risk management within AWS CAF helps you identify, assess, and mitigate any risks of cloud adoption for your use case. Risk management does not specifically address defining and tracking business outcomes.

Cloud financial management helps you manage and optimize cloud costs and investments. Cloud financial management involves tracking financial metrics. However, this capability does not help you define and track overall business outcomes for cloud transformation.

Benefits management within AWS CAF helps you define, track, and realize business outcomes from cloud investments. Benefits management helps you identify, measure, and communicate the business value that cloud adoption can provide. You can use this capability to track transformation outcomes.

Application portfolio management helps you plan and manage your application portfolio during cloud migration. Application portfolio management helps you determine your migration strategy. However, this capability does not help you define and track business outcomes.

question: Which AWS service offers the MOST cost-effective means of storing static images?

options.explanation: Amazon S3 is the most cost effective option to store static images because you only pay for what you use.

Amazon EFS provides scalable file storage but is designed and priced for active file system workloads rather than static content storage. While EFS can store images, the pricing model is higher per GB than Amazon S3 for static content.
DynamoDB is a NoSQL key value database. You can use DynamoDB to store JSON documents, but you cannot store images in DynamoDB.

Amazon EBS pricing is based on the amount of storage provisioned and the level of performance required. Although you can use Amazon EBS to store static images, Amazon S3 is more cost-effective for storing images on a price-per-GB basis.

question: According to the AWS shared responsibility model, which security-related tasks are the customer's responsibility?

options.explanation: Customer data integrity is the responsibility of the customer. The customer must ensure data remains protected by using services that AWS offers.
Hardware security of AWS data centers within Regions is the responsibility of AWS.
Client-side data encryption is the responsibility of the customer.
The network security of the AWS global infrastructure is the responsibility of AWS.
The security of physical edge locations is the responsibility of AWS.

question: What is an IAM best practice for AWS account root user access keys?

options.text: Use root user credentials to access sensitive information stored on AWS.
options.explanation: Access to sensitive information should be restricted by using IAM identities. It is not recommended to use root credentials for daily work. A policy can be created and assigned to groups or users that need to access this sensitive information.

options.text: Allow the system administrator group to use the root user credentials for daily access.

options.text: Regions are within 100 km (60 miles) of each other.

question: Which AWS Cloud design principles can help increase reliability?

options.explanation: In a monolithic architecture, all of your components are tightly coupled, which means that they run as a single service. Using a monolithic architecture goes against the AWS Well-Architected Framework. A micro-service oriented architecture is recommended.

question: What is an AWS best practice for managing an AWS account root user?

options.text: Share the root user password with the operations team.
options.explanation: It is against AWS best practices to share the root user password.

options.text: Create an access key for the root user.

options.explanation: It is an AWS best practice to turn on MFA for all users, including the root user.

question: Which AWS service should be used to monitor Amazon EC2 instances for CPU and network utilization?

options.explanation: CloudTrail logs API activity as event history within your AWS account, which can help with monitoring, governance, and compliance. The logs record actions taken in your AWS account, such as actions taken by a user or role. CloudTrail does not monitor EC2 instances for CPU and network utilization.

CloudWatch monitors resources and collects real-time logs. The logs can give you insight on your resource's overall health. With the CloudWatch agent installed on an EC2 instance, you can monitor your EC2 instances for CPU and network utilization.

AWS Config analyzes past and present configurations of your resources. AWS Config can help keep your resource configurations compliant with remediation rules that can detect and reverse configurations changes. AWS Config does not monitor EC2 instances for CPU and network utilization.
Amazon Inspector searches for security vulnerabilities in software and network best practices. Although Amazon Inspector can scan EC2 instances, it does not monitor for CPU and network utilization.

question: Which feature can be used to protect Amazon S3 buckets from accidental overwrites or deletions?

options.explanation: Bucket versioning gives you the ability to maintain multiple versions of an object in an S3 bucket. Therefore, if you accidentally delete or overwrite an object, Amazon S3 does not remove the object permanently. Instead, Amazon S3 inserts a delete marker for the object in buckets with versioning turned on. This feature gives you the ability to restore previous versions of every object that is stored in the bucket.
You can use server-side encryption to protect data that is stored in Amazon S3. However, server-side encryption does not prevent overwrites or deletions.
You can use S3 access points to simplify access to a subset of objects in an S3 bucket. However, S3 access points do not prevent overwrites or deletions.
You can use lifecycle policies to set rules to transition objects to different storage classes. You cannot use lifecycle policies to protect S3 buckets from overwrites or deletions.

question: A company needs to generate reports for business intelligence and operational analytics on petabytes of semi-structured and structured data. These reports are produced from standard SQL queries on data that is in an Amazon S3 data lake. Which AWS service provides the ability to analyze this data?

options.explanation: Amazon RDS is a managed relational database service for operational database workloads. Amazon RDS supports SQL queries. However, Amazon RDS is not designed to analyze petabytes of data in S3 data lakes. Instead, Amazon RDS is optimized for transactional processing and day-to-day database operations.

Amazon Redshift is a fully managed data warehouse service. Amazon Redshift can analyze petabyte-scale data by using standard SQL queries. You can directly query data that is stored in S3 data lakes by using Amazon Redshift Spectrum. Therefore, this service is suitable for business intelligence and operational analytics on large-scale semi-structured and structured data.

DynamoDB is a fully managed NoSQL database service. DynamoDB is designed for high-performance applications that need consistent single-digit millisecond latency. DynamoDB does not support standard SQL queries. DynamoDB is not designed to analyze petabytes of data in S3 data lakes.

Neptune is a fully managed graph database service that can store billions of relationships. Neptune can query a graph with millisecond latency. Neptune is not designed for SQL-based analytics on semi-structured and structured data in S3 data lakes.

question: An online retail company has seasonal sales spikes several times a year, primarily around holidays. Demand is lower at other times. The company finds it difficult to predict the increasing infrastructure demand for each season. Which advantages of moving to the AWS Cloud would MOST benefit the company?

options.explanation: Elasticity is a benefit that eliminates the need to guess infrastructure capacity needs, and gives you the ability to scale up and down a needed. Because the company has seasonal spikes in demand, elasticity of the cloud is an advantage the company could benefit from.

The pay-as-you-go pricing model is a benefit of the AWS Cloud. This model gives you the ability to pay for only the resources that you use. Instead of investing in data centers and servers, you pay only when and how many computing resources are consumed. This pricing model would give the company the ability to pay for resources only when they use them, especially during seasonal spikes in demand.
The AWS shared responsibility model outlines user security responsibilities in the cloud and AWS security responsibilities of the cloud.
The ability to have global reach is a benefit of cloud computing. However, the global reach is not directly related to the company's need to increase and decrease capacity to match seasonal spikes.

Service quotas are checks for the serve limits for a specific AWS service. Service quotas are not a benefit of cloud computing. Service quotas are related to how many resources you can create and deploy.

question: According to the AWS shared responsibility model, which task is the responsibility of AWS for workloads running on Amazon EC2?

options.explanation: It is the responsibility of AWS to ensure the security and compliance of the AWS Cloud, which includes physical hardware.
Any data that is owned by the user, which includes user data, is the responsibility of the user to secure, update, and maintain.
The database engine that runs on an EC2 instance is the responsibility of the user. Therefore, the user is also responsible for the update of the database engine.
It is the responsibility of the user to patch operating systems.

question: An application is receiving SQL injection attacks from multiple external resources. Which AWS service or feature can help automate mitigation against these attacks?

options.explanation: Network ACL rules can allow or deny traffic based on only port, protocols, or IP addresses. Network ACLs cannot filter SQL injection attacks, and, therefore, cannot provide mitigation against these attacks.

AWS WAF is a web application firewall that helps protect your web applications from common web exploits that could affect application availability, compromise security, or consume excessive resources.
Security groups are used to manage traffic from specific IP addresses or ranges to specific ports. Security groups do not mitigate against SQL injection attacks.
ELB is used to distribute traffic or requests across a pool of resources. ELB does not filter URL traffic. Instead, ELB passes the request to the resource.

question: Which AWS service provides a simple way to set up a new multi-account AWS environment and govern it at scale?

options.explanation: Security Hub provides a comprehensive view of how your AWS environment compares to security standards best practices. Security Hub also provides you with high-priority security alerts or findings. Security Hub is not used to set up and govern a multi-account environment.
Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) gives you the ability to share AWS resources with any AWS account within AWS Organization.
AWS Control Tower provides you with the ability to set up, govern, and manage multiple AWS accounts.
Trusted Advisor is used to inspect and provide recommendations for areas to improve your AWS environment. Trusted Advisor is not used to set up and govern a multi-account environment.

question: After selecting an Amazon EC2 Dedicated Host reservation, which pricing option would provide the largest discount?

options.explanation: Hourly, on-demand pricing provides flexibility in usage. However, this pricing structure does not provide the largest discount.
No upfront payment means that you do not need to provide any initial payment to reserve the Dedicated Host. However, this pricing option does not provide the largest discount.
All upfront pricing requires you to pay everything ahead of time. This pricing option provides the largest discount.
Partial upfront payment has a lower initial cash payment. However, this type of payment does not provide the largest discount.

question: A user needs to perform a one-time backup of an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that is attached to an Amazon EC2 instance. What is the MOST operationally efficient way to perform this backup?

options.text: Create an EBS snapshot of the volume.
options.explanation: An EBS snapshot is a built-in feature that provides a point-in-time backup of an EBS volume. An EBS snapshot requires only a single API call or a single click. Snapshots are incremental. AWS automatically stores EBS snapshots in Amazon S3. You can create an EBS snapshot while the volume is attached and in use. This is the most operationally efficient way to perform a backup because you use built-in AWS functionality with minimal effort.

options.text: Create a custom script to copy the EBS file contents to Amazon S3.
options.explanation: You can create and maintain a custom script to copy contents to Amazon S3. However, this approach requires development effort, testing, and ongoing maintenance. This approach is not as operationally efficient as using a built-in capability of Amazon EBS.

options.text: Attach another EBS volume to the EC2 instance, and copy the contents.
options.explanation: You can attach another EBS volume and copy the contents. However, this approach requires multiple manual steps. You must attach the new volume, mount the volume, and manage the copy process. This approach is not the most operationally efficient.

options.text: Copy the EBS volume to a server that is running outside AWS and is connected with AWS Direct Connect.
options.explanation: You can use Direct Connect to connect an internal network to the AWS Cloud through an Ethernet fiber-optic cable. You can copy an EBS volume to an external server over Direct Connect. However, this approach is not the most operationally efficient way to perform the backup. This approach requires additional infrastructure and complex data transfer processes. This approach is both time-consuming and resource-intensive.

question: Which responsibility is shared between the user and AWS?

options.text: Control the environment of physical AWS data centers
options.explanation: AWS is responsible for the protection of the infrastructure that runs all of the services offered in the AWS Cloud.
AWS trains AWS employees, but a user must train their own employees. Therefore, this responsibility is a shared control.

Amazon EC2 is categorized as infrastructure as a service (IaaS). Amazon EC2 requires the user to perform the necessary security configuration and management tasks. The configuration of an EC2 instance is a user's responsibility.

options.text: Provide a key for Amazon S3 client-side encryption
options.explanation: It is the user’s responsibility to provide client-side encryption keys. Users often must maintain their own keys because of regulatory requirements.

question: Which AWS service can generate a finding when personally identifiable information (PII) is stored within an Amazon S3 bucket?

options.explanation: GuardDuty is a threat detection service that can monitor AWS accounts and workloads for malicious activity. GuardDuty can generate security findings and remediation suggestions. However, GuardDuty does not generate a finding when PII is stored in an S3 bucket.

Amazon Inspector is an automated vulnerability management service that scans your AWS workloads for software vulnerabilities or unintended network exposure. Amazon Inspector does not generate a finding when PII is stored in an S3 bucket.
Trusted Advisor can evaluate your AWS account and provide recommendations to help you follow AWS best practices. Trusted Advisor does not generate a finding when PII is stored in an S3 bucket.

Macie applies machine learning and pattern matching techniques to identify sensitive data, including PII. Macie can generate a finding if sensitive data is found. You can select specific S3 buckets for Macie to search.

question: A system automatically recovers from failure when a company launches its workload on the AWS Cloud services platform. Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework does this situation demonstrate?

options.explanation: The performance efficiency pillar focuses on structured and streamlined allocation of IT and computing resources. Key topics include how to select resource types and sizes optimized for workload requirements, monitor performance, and maintain efficiency as business needs evolve.

The cost optimization pillar focuses on how to avoid unnecessary costs. Key topics include how to spend over time and control fund allocation, select resources of the right type and quantity, and scale to meet business needs without overspending.

The reliability pillar focuses on workloads that perform their intended functions and how to recover quickly from failure to meet demands. One of the design principles of the reliability pillar is automatic recovery from failure.

The operational excellence pillar focuses on how to run and monitor systems, and continually improve processes and procedures. Key topics include how to automate changes, respond to events, and define standards to manage daily operations.

question: A company runs MySQL database workloads on self-managed servers in an on-premises data center. The company wants to migrate the database workloads to an AWS managed service. Which migration strategy should the company use? Confidence Level Unsure

options.explanation: Replatform is also known as lift and reshape. The replatform migration strategy involves making targeted optimizations to achieve tangible benefits without changing the core architecture. You can move MySQL databases from self-managed servers to an AWS managed service such as Amazon RDS. This strategy maintains the same database engine and uses an AWS managed service for reduced operational overhead.

Rehost is also known as lift and shift. The rehost migration strategy involves moving applications to AWS without making changes to the architecture. This strategy would keep the MySQL databases as self-managed workloads. However, the workloads would run on AWS instead of on premises. This strategy does not meet the requirement to migrate to an AWS managed service.

Repurchase is also known as drop and shop. The repurchase migration strategy involves moving to a different product. Repurchasing typically involves purchasing new software licenses. This strategy is not suitable for migrating existing MySQL database workloads. You would need to replace the database workloads with entirely different products.

The refactor migration strategy involves re-architecting and re-coding portions of an application to benefit from cloud features. This level of change is not necessary to migrate MySQL database workloads to a managed service.

question: Which of the following is a benefit of using an AWS managed service?

options.text: Increased fixed costs that can be predicted by a finance team
options.explanation: One benefit of AWS Cloud computing is to trade fixed costs for variable costs. Therefore, an increase in fixed costs is not a benefit.

options.text: Reduced operational overhead for a company's IT staff
options.explanation: Generally, companies can save annually on operational costs by using AWS managed services with operational best practices.

options.text: Removal of the need to follow compliance standards
options.explanation: AWS supports a comprehensive list of security standards and compliance controls. However, to meet compliance standards is a shared responsibility between AWS and AWS customers. The use of managed services alone would not remove the need to follow compliance standards.

options.text: Removal of the need to have a backup strategy
options.explanation: Some AWS managed services perform backups on behalf of the user. However, users should also have proper backup strategies in place.

question: Which tasks require use of the AWS account root user?

options.explanation: You must use the root user account to restore IAM permissions if the only IAM administrator accidentally revokes their own permissions.
The root account must be used to close an AWS account.

options.text: Grouping resources in AWS Systems Manager
options.explanation: You are not required to access the root user account to use Systems Manager. An IAM user with the necessary permissions can work with AWS Systems Manager.

options.text: Modifying an Amazon EC2 instance type
options.explanation: You are not required to access the root user account to modify an EC2 instance type. An IAM user with the necessary permissions can modify an EC2 instance type.

options.text: Running applications in Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)
options.explanation: You are not required to access the root account to use Amazon EKS. An IAM user with the necessary permissions can run microservices applications in Amazon EKS.

question: A company is launching a new application in the AWS Cloud. The application will run on an Amazon EC2 instance. More EC2 instances will be needed when the workload increases. Which AWS service or tool can the company use to launch the number of EC2 instances that will be needed to handle the workload? Confidence Level Confident

options.explanation: You can use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling to automatically make more EC2 instances available to handle the load for your application.

Systems Manager offers features to manage and to gain operational insights into resources on AWS, on premises, and on other clouds. Systems Manager does not launch additional EC2 instances to handle the increased load on an application.

App2Container is a command line tool. You can use App2Container to lift and shift the applications from your on-premises data centers or virtual machines to container platforms on AWS. App2Container can run on containers managed by Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), or AWS App Runner.
ELB automatically distributes incoming traffic across multiple targets, including EC2 instances, containers, and IP addresses. ELB does not launch new instances when the load increases.

question: A company is building an application that requires the ability to send, store, and receive messages between application components. The company has another requirement to process messages in first-in, first-out (FIFO) order. Which AWS service should the company use?

options.explanation: Amazon SNS is a publish/subscribe messaging service. Amazon SNS pushes messages to subscribers, rather than providing message storage and retrieval. Amazon SNS does not meet the requirement to store and process messages in FIFO order.

Step Functions is a serverless workflow service that you can use to coordinate multiple AWS services into serverless workflows. Step Functions is designed to orchestrate complex workflows with various steps and states. However, you would not use Step Functions for messaging between application components. Step Functions does not provide a message queue with FIFO capabilities.

Amazon SQS is a fully managed message queuing service. You can use Amazon SQS to decouple and scale microservices, distributed systems, and serverless applications. Amazon SQS provides standard queues and FIFO queues. FIFO queues process messages once in the exact order that the messages were sent.

Kinesis Data Streams is a real-time data streaming service that can handle ordered data. However, Kinesis Data Streams is designed for high-volume streaming data use cases. Kinesis Data Streams is not a message queuing service. Kinesis Data Streams does not provide FIFO capabilities.

question: What is an example of high availability in the AWS Cloud?

options.text: Consulting AWS technical support at any time of the day
options.explanation: Technical support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. However, this is not a high availability arrangement for your application. There is downtime when you call technical support. High availability prevents downtime.

options.text: Ensuring that an application remains accessible, even if a resource fails
options.explanation: High availability in the AWS Cloud ensures that an application remains accessible, even if a resource fails. High availability architecture is designed to have no single point of failure.

options.text: Making any AWS service available for use by paying on demand
options.explanation: This option is an example of pay-as-you-go pricing rather than high availability.

options.text: Deploying in any part of the world by using AWS Regions
options.explanation: This option is an example of the global presence of AWS, not high availability.

question: Which AWS compute service is serverless?

options.explanation: Amazon RDS is not a serverless service. Amazon RDS runs a database engine on top of DB instances. When you create a database by using Amazon RDS, you must first select the DB instance size and type as part of the capacity planning process. Then, as the Amazon RDS storage or usage capacity gets consumed, you must implement capacity provisioning and management tasks. AWS does not automatically handle the capacity and management tasks.

Lambda is a serverless service. When you use Lambda, you upload code and choose an event that will determine when the function runs. AWS manages all the patches, infrastructure maintenance, and capacity planning of Lambda.

Amazon EC2 is not a serverless service. Amazon EC2 provides secure, resizable compute capacity in the cloud. When you provision an EC2 instance, you have access to the EC2 instance and operating system to implement patches or maintenance tasks. When you use Amazon EC2, you must implement infrastructure management tasks like capacity provisioning.

Amazon ECS is not a serverless service in all use cases. Amazon ECS is a container orchestration service that gives you the ability to run containers on various platforms. You can run the containers on an Amazon EC2 based compute platform, on external instances, or on an AWS Fargate serverless compute platform. With Amazon EC2 based compute clusters as the host platform, you must manage the compute cluster that the containers are hosted on. This use case requires you to manage capacity planning and patching tasks. Therefore, in this use case, Amazon ECS is not serverless.

question: Which AWS offering can be natively associated with AWS WAF?

options.explanation: GWLBs operate at layer 3/4 of the OSI model. Layer 3/4 is the network layer. GWLBs can deploy, scale, and manage virtual appliances. You cannot directly associate a GWLB with AWS WAF. GWLBs do not operate at the application layer.
NLBs operate at layer 4 of the OSI model. Layer 4 is the transport layer. You cannot directly associate an NLB with AWS WAF. AWS WAF requires layer 7 capabilities to inspect and filter web traffic.

You can directly associate an ALB with AWS WAF to protect web applications from common web exploits. ALBs operate at layer 7 of the OSI model. Layer 7 is the application layer. Therefore, ALBs are compatible with AWS WAF web traffic filtering capabilities. You can integrate these AWS offerings to implement web ACLs directly on your ALB.

Lambda is a compute service that you can use to run code without the need to manage servers. You can use Lambda to create custom AWS WAF rules or to process AWS WAF logs. However, you cannot directly associate Lambda with AWS WAF.

question: Which AWS service or tool can a company use to visualize, understand, and manage AWS spending and usage over time?

options.explanation: Cost Explorer gives you the ability to visualize, understand, and manage your AWS spending and usage over time.

AWS Budgets gives you the ability to set custom budgets. You can receive alerts when you exceed the spending or usage thresholds that you set in your budget. You would not use AWS Budgets to visualize or understand AWS spending and usage over time.
Trusted Advisor analyzes your AWS environment and provides best practice recommendations. You would not use Trusted Advisor to visualize or understand spending and usage over time.
You can use CloudWatch to monitor the performance of AWS workloads. You would not use CloudWatch to visualize or understand AWS spending and usage over time.

question: A company hosts an application on an Amazon EC2 instance. The EC2 instance needs to access several AWS resources, including Amazon S3 and Amazon DynamoDB. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution to delegate permissions?

options.text: Create an IAM user and use its access key and secret access key to create a CLI profile in the EC2 instance.
options.explanation: A solution that creates an IAM user and uses its access key and secret access key in a profile is not necessary. This solution is not a security best practice. The best solution would be to attach an IAM role with appropriate permissions to the EC2 instance.

options.text: Create an IAM role with the required permissions. Attach the role to the administrative IAM user.
options.explanation: To create an IAM role with appropriate permissions would be the correct solution. However, you should attach the IAM role to the EC2 instance, not to an IAM user.

options.text: Create an IAM role with the required permissions. Attach the role to the EC2 instance.
options.explanation: A solution that creates an IAM role with appropriate permissions and attaches the role to the EC2 instance will provide access to the AWS resources. This solution is a security best practice.

options.text: Create an IAM user and use its access key and secret access key in the application.
options.explanation: A solution that includes access keys and secret access keys in application code is not necessary. This solution is not a security best practice. The best solution would be to attach an IAM role with appropriate permissions to the EC2 instance.

question: According to the AWS shared responsibility model, which of the following tasks are AWS responsibilities?

options.explanation: It is the user's responsibility to manage their data, which includes encryption.

options.text: The physical security of AWS facilities.
options.explanation: It is the responsibility of AWS to maintain the physical security of facilities.

options.text: Patching operating systems on Amazon EC2.
options.explanation: It is the user's responsibility to manage and patch the operating system on their EC2 instances.

options.text: Defining network firewalls inside the VPC.
options.explanation: It is the user's responsibility to define and configure security groups in the VPC because it is considered security in the cloud.
It is the responsibility of AWS to patch and update the hypervisor because it is considered security of the cloud.

question: A company has existing software licenses that it wants to bring to AWS, but the licensing model requires licensing physical cores. How can the company meet this requirement in the AWS Cloud?

options.text: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance with default tenancy.
options.explanation: Default tenancy automatically applies to an EC2 instance that you launch on demand. AWS places the EC2 instance on physical hardware that you share with other accounts. You have no control of the physical layer. Therefore, you would not be able to use the existing software license on the physical cores.

You can reserve a set number of On-Demand EC2 instances with shared tenancy in an Availability Zone. This solution makes On-Demand EC2 instances available when needed. However, a solution that creates an On-Demand Capacity Reservation would not meet the requirement of licensing physical cores.

Dedicated Reserved Instances give you the ability to launch an EC2 instance on a physical server that is isolated from other accounts. The account user must commit for 1 year or 3 years. Dedicated Reserved Instances do not give you the ability to control the physical layer of the instance.

options.text: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance on a Dedicated Host.
options.explanation: A Dedicated Host can isolate EC2 instances from other accounts. You can control portions of the physical layer. Dedicated Hosts give you the ability to use existing software licenses.

question: A company is moving its office and must establish an encrypted connection to AWS. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?

options.explanation: Route 53 is a DNS web service offered by AWS. You can use Route 53 for domain registration, DNS routing, and health checks.
You can use Amazon Connect to set up a scalable contact center in the AWS Cloud. You would not use Amazon Connect to encrypt traffic between two different networks.
AWS provides AWS VPN as a managed service. AWS VPN establishes a secure encrypted connection between AWS and your on-premises or branch-office networks.
You can use Direct Connect to privately connect your on-premises network to the AWS Cloud. However, communication over Direct Connect is not encrypted.

question: A company has a Java web application. The company wants to use auto deployment to create the AWS environment and deploy new versions of its application. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?

options.explanation: AWS Auto Scaling monitors applications or workloads that run on AWS and automatically adjusts the resource capacity to meet demand. AWS Auto Scaling does not create the resources necessary to deploy an application.
AWS Control Tower provides a way to create and manage a multi-account environment that follows AWS best practices. AWS Control Tower does not create the resources necessary to deploy an application.

Elastic Beanstalk deploys and scales web applications and services. First, you upload your code to Elastic Beanstalk. Then, Elastic Beanstalk automatically manages the deployment. Additionally, Elastic Beanstalk manages capacity provisioning, load balancing, auto scaling, and application health monitoring.
Amazon EC2 provides scalable compute servers in the AWS Cloud. Customers manage EC2 instances. Amazon EC2 does not provide the automatic deployment functionality required in this scenario.

question: A company wants to continuously monitor AWS account activity, including actions taken through the AWS Management Console, AWS software development kits (SDKs), and command line tools. Which AWS service meets these requirements?

options.explanation: Trusted Advisor inspects your AWS environment and makes recommendations to help you save money and to improve security, performance, and the availability of resources. However, Trusted Advisor does not monitor activity in an AWS account.
CloudTrail continuously monitors and logs activity in an AWS account. CloudTrail logs include actions that users take through the console, SDKs, API calls, and the AWS CLI.

CloudWatch continually monitors and collects metrics on resources and applications that run on AWS in real time. You can use the metrics to gain insights, create alarms, and send notifications. You can integrate CloudWatch with CloudTrail. However, by itself CloudWatch does not monitor activity in an AWS account.

Amazon Inspector searches for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure in select AWS resources. The resources include Amazon EC2 instances, AWS Lambda functions, and container images that are stored in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Amazon Inspector does not monitor activity in an AWS account.

question: Which option is an AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) foundational capability for the operations perspective?

options.explanation: Application portfolio management is a capability of the governance perspective in AWS CAF.
Product management is a capability of the business perspective in AWS CAF.
Identity and access management is a capability of the security perspective in AWS CAF.
Performance and capacity management is a capability of the operations perspective in AWS CAF.

question: Which of the following are security best practices for using AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)?

options.text: Use inline policies instead of customer managed policies.
options.explanation: You should use customer managed policies instead of inline policies. Inline policies attach to a single IAM identity. However, you can apply customer managed policies to multiple principal entities.
It is an AWS best practice to require MFA for privileged users. MFA requires another authentication factor to sign in. Therefore, MFA provides an additional layer of security.

options.text: Use AWS account root user credentials for IAM tasks.
options.explanation: It is against AWS best practices to use the root user for non-essential tasks. You should only use root user credentials for tasks that require the root user.
It is an AWS best practice to rotate credentials regularly.

options.text: Do not remove credentials, even if they are never used.
options.explanation: It is an AWS best practice to regularly review and remove unnecessary credentials.

question: Which AWS service provides on-demand downloads of AWS security and compliance documentation?

options.explanation: Trusted Advisor is a service that inspects your AWS environment, compares against best practices, and makes recommendations for environment cost, performance, and security optimization. Trusted Advisor does not provide on- demand downloads of AWS security and compliance documentation.

Amazon Inspector is a service that scans your AWS environment for software vulnerabilities and network exposure. Amazon Inspector produces data that helps identify issues, but it does not provide on-demand downloads of AWS security and compliance documentation.
Directory Service offers a variety of options to use Microsoft Active Directory with other AWS services. It does not provide on-demand downloads of AWS security and compliance documentation.
AWS Artifact provides access to third-party assessments of AWS security and compliance responsibilities outlined within the AWS shared responsibility model.

question: What is a benefit of the pay-as-you-go pricing model for AWS services?

options.explanation: With AWS Cloud computing, you can trade fixed costs for variable costs by only paying for the resources that you use.

options.text: Relevant only for Amazon EC2, Amazon S3, and Amazon RDS
options.explanation: AWS offers pay-as-you-go pricing for more than 200 services.

options.text: Requires payment up front for AWS services
options.explanation: AWS provides services on an as-needed basis. AWS services are billed monthly. Reserved Instances provide a greater discount if you pay in advance. However, Reserved Instances are not part of the pay-as-you-go model.
With AWS Cloud computing, you can trade fixed costs for variable costs. Additionally, the variable costs might be lower than what you would pay otherwise because of economies of scale.

question: A company needs to deploy an Amazon EC2 instance and attach a storage mount for the operating system and application files. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?

options.explanation: AWS Backup is a fully managed service that automates and centralizes backups of data from multiple AWS storage services and on-premises storage systems. AWS Backup does not provide a storage mount for operating system and application files.
Amazon EBS is a high-performance block-storage service that you can use with EC2 instances. You can use Amazon EBS to mount operating system and application files.
Amazon S3 is an object-based storage with unlimited scalability. You cannot use Amazon S3 to mount operating system files for EC2 instances.
Amazon EFS provides a serverless, fully scalable shared file system. You cannot use Amazon EFS to mount operating system files for EC2 instances.

question: What are the benefits of using the AWS Cloud?

options.text: Ability to deploy globally in minutes
options.explanation: The ability to easily deploy your application in multiple AWS Regions around the world is a benefit of using the AWS Cloud. This type of deployment means that you can provide lower latency and a better experience for your users.

AWS builds security into every Cloud service, but while AWS manages security of the cloud, you are responsible for security in the cloud. This means that you retain control of the security you choose to implement to protect your own content, platform, applications, systems, and networks no differently than you would in an on-premises data center.

The AWS Cloud offers you simpler access to new IT resources. This means that you can reduce the time to make those resources available to your developers from weeks to just minutes. This can result in an increase in agility for the company, because the cost and time it takes to experiment and develop could be lower.

options.text: All user data is backed up globally
options.explanation: Depending on the Cloud service used, data might be replicated automatically by AWS within the same AWS Region (for example, with Amazon S3). Or data might need to be manually backed up by you (for example, with applications running on Amazon EC2). Your data will never leave the AWS Region without your explicit consent.

options.text: Removes the need to patch user software
options.explanation: Using the AWS Cloud does not remove the need to apply software patches to your applications.

question: Which AWS service helps users to collect, process, and analyze real-time streaming data from sources including operating logs, financial transactions, and social media feeds?

options.explanation: Athena is an interactive query service that gives you the ability to analyze data in Amazon S3 by using standard SQL. You can use Athena to query data that was already collected. Therefore, Athena can help you analyze data. However, Athena does not provide a way to collect or process real-time streaming data.

Kinesis gives you the ability to collect, process, and analyze real-time streaming data. Kinesis provides timely insights so that you can react quickly to new information. Kinesis can ingest real-time data from video, audio, application logs, and website clickstreams. Additionally, Kinesis can ingest IoT telemetry data for machine learning, analytics, and other applications. Kinesis gives you the ability to process and analyze data when the data arrives. Then, you can respond instantly. You do not have to wait until all your data is collected before you can process the data.

Direct Connect is a service that gives you the ability to establish a private fiber network connection to AWS from an on- premises data center. With Direct Connect, you can send information to and from AWS through your connection. However, Direct Connect does not specifically help users to collect, process, or analyze real-time streaming data. Direct Connect does not include any software to help streaming use cases.

Amazon Redshift is a fast and scalable data warehouse that gives you the ability to analyze all of your data across your data warehouse and data lake. Amazon Redshift gives you the ability to analyze data that was collected from real-time sources. However, Amazon Redshift does not provide a way to collect or process real-time streaming data.

question: After a merger, a company inherits an AWS account with an existing infrastructure. The company needs to ensure that the infrastructure follows AWS best practices for cost optimization, security, and performance efficiency. Which AWS service or tool should the company use to meet these requirements?

options.explanation: The AWS WA Tool gives you the ability to review and compare your architecture with AWS best practices. The AWS WA Tool provides recommendations to make workloads more reliable, secure, efficient, and cost effective.
Cost Explorer gives you the ability to visualize, understand, and manage your AWS cost and usage over time. However, Cost Explorer does not compare workloads with AWS best practices.

You can use AWS Config to provide an overview and configuration of your AWS resources. AWS Config can provide information about security. However, AWS Config does not provide best practices on performance.
Compute Optimizer does provide performance optimization. However, Compute Optimizer does not provide any recommendations or best practices for security.

question: A company is running a web application on Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants the application's compute capacity to automatically adjust to meet customer demand. Which AWS service or capability should the company use to meet this requirement?

options.explanation: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling will adjust the number of EC2 instances in your workload based on demand. Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling will scale out when demand is high. Scaling out will meet the need of the traffic that enters your cloud environment. Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling will scale in when demand is low to optimize your costs.
Lightsail provides virtual private servers for web applications. Lightsail does not provide automatic adjustment of compute capacity based on customer demand.

Compute Optimizer analyzes compute usage and makes recommendations for your workloads. The reports help to determine if you are over-provisioning or under-provisioning your use of compute services. The goal of Compute Optimizer is to optimize costs. Compute Optimizer does not automatically adjust compute capacity.
Amazon EC2 Capacity Reservations are used to reserve capacity for EC2 instances in a specific Availability Zone. Capacity Reservations do not automatically adjust capacity based on demand.

question: Which of the following are pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework?

options.explanation: Performance efficiency is one of the six pillars of the Well-Architected Framework.

High availability refers to an environment that can continue to run with little or no downtime, even when there are failures. High availability is not a pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework. The six pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework are operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability.
Sustainability is one of the six pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

Multiple Availability Zones gives you the ability to distribute your workload in case of failure. Multiple Availability Zones is not a pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework. The six pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework are operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability.

Encryption refers to how to add an extra layer of security to your data usage. Encryption usage is not a pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework. The six pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework are operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability.

question: Which AWS service helps users meet contractual and regulatory compliance requirements for data security by using dedicated hardware appliances within the AWS Cloud?

options.explanation: With Secrets Manager, you can rotate, manage, and retrieve database credentials, API keys, and other secrets throughout their lifecycle. Secrets Manager does not provide dedicated hardware appliances.
Directory Service is a managed Microsoft Active Directory service. Directory Service does not provide dedicated hardware appliances.
AWS KMS is a managed service to create and control the encryption keys used to encrypt your data. AWS KMS does not provide dedicated hardware appliances.
CloudHSM helps you comply with corporate, contractual, and regulatory compliance requirements for data security by using dedicated hardware security module (HSM) appliances within the AWS Cloud.

question: A company requires physical isolation of its Amazon EC2 instances from the instances of other customers. Which instance purchasing option meets this requirement?

options.explanation: Reserved Instances are not physical instances. Reserved Instances are a billing discount applied to the use of On-Demand Instances in your account. Reserved Instances do not provide physical workload isolation.
With Dedicated Hosts, a physical server is dedicated for your use. Dedicated Hosts provide visibility and the option to control how you place your instances on an isolated, physical server.
With Spot Instances, you can take advantage of unused EC2 capacity in the AWS Cloud. Spot Instances do not provide physical workload isolation.
With On-Demand Instances, you pay for compute capacity by the second with no long-term commitments. On-Demand Instances do not provide physical workload isolation.

question: Which AWS service or tool reduces latency for static websites running on AWS?

options.explanation: CloudFront is a content delivery network with edge locations around the globe.
AWS Data Exchange is a service used to find and use third-party data. AWS Data Exchange does not deliver website content.
Lambda is a serverless compute service that you can use to customize web content. Lambda will not accelerate website delivery on its own.
S3 Transfer Acceleration enables fast, easy, and secure transfers of files over long distances between your client and an S3 bucket. S3 Transfer Acceleration does not deliver website content.

question: A company does not own a physical data center but needs a network solution that connects employee laptops directly to the AWS Cloud. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?

options.explanation: Amazon Connect is an omnichannel cloud contact center that helps you provide superior customer service at a lower cost. Amazon Connect provides a seamless experience across voice and chat for your customers and agents. Amazon Connect is not a service that connects an on-premises network to AWS.

Site-to-Site VPN creates an encrypted network path between your on-premises network and your AWS Cloud network. This connection uses the internet. Site-to-Site VPN provides a network level connection to AWS from on-premises data centers, not from laptops.

Direct Connect links your internal network to a Direct Connect location through a standard Ethernet fiber-optic cable. One end of the cable connects to your router. The other end of the cable connects to a Direct Connect router. Direct Connect provides a network level connection to AWS from on-premises data centers, not from laptops.

Client VPN is a managed client-based VPN service that gives you the ability to securely access your AWS resources and the resources in your on-premises network. With Client VPN, you can access your resources from any location through an OpenVPN-based VPN client.
